description: Record payments against a debt — **several in one call**. The amount is a magnitude; the direction is known. A payment is **all principal** unless it names an interest portion, because v1 has no amortization schedule. Paying more than is outstanding is allowed and is flagged. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Payments the app discovered at import are a separate thing and are confirmed in the app.

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

payments.description: One entry per payment. Up to 60 in a call.

amount.description: What was paid, in major units, positive.

debt.description: The debt, by id or by name. It must already exist.

interest_portion.description: How much of the payment was interest. Defaults to 0, which makes the whole payment come off the principal.

note.description: Anything worth keeping about this payment.

name: record_debt_payments
title: Record debt payments
